reason: I already pay for Jobber and don't want another monthly subscription for something nobody outside the owner's own company has paid for. I might poke at the free trial, but I wouldn't pay yet.
objection: No outside customers, no reviews, no case studies. I'd be the guinea pig, and if it botches a lead or double-books a tech, that costs me real jobs.
would_change_my_mind: Several paying home-service companies my size who will talk to me, plus proof it plugs into Jobber/Housecall Pro so I don't have to switch or enter things twice.
